method: Downloaded artifact hash verified. Decoded occurrence inheritance according to v1 field mask; compared all decoded hits by query and ID with full expanded capture. Serialized canonical JSON UTF-8 sizes of decoded and compact hits only; not model tokens. Added envelope_tokens + results_tokens from recorded budget ledger, without final response overhead.

unmatched.reason: not present in expanded capture; no independent full equivalent to compare

limitations: Comparison does not cover all client integrations or independently validate the unmatched record.

Engine's configured budget is an allocation estimate with capped metadata reserve, not a strict end-to-end response token limit. Uncapped sums still exclude final ledger/result-list overhead and are not tokenizer counts.
No independent evaluation, no ranker changes, no production adoption.
